request: Please drop automatic decoding of compress(1) archives during searches, since we would rather report unsupported inputs than launch a legacy helper.

source.request: Please drop automatic decoding of compress(1) archives during searches, since we would rather report unsupported inputs than launch a legacy helper.
source.settled: grep-cli supports searching files compressed by compress(1).
source.why: Rejecting these compressed inputs removes the format support added by the ticket.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
